items.title: Obtain a Kent County building permit
items.authority: Kent County Levy Court Department of Planning Services
items.description: Construction projects in Kent County that fall under the county's adopted building codes need the applicable building, residential or related permit before work begins; confirm the project-specific requirements with the county.

feeDetail.note: The applicable authority sets fees by license or permit type; confirm the current schedule before filing.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Get a New Castle County contractor license
items.authority: New Castle County Land Use, Permit Section
items.description: A contractor doing construction work in New Castle County that needs a building, mechanical or plumbing permit must hold a county contractor license. The county requires a State of Delaware business license first and identifies the business by its federal EIN, and the Permit Section can be reached at 302-395-5420. The county's online lookup shows the license fee for payment, and its page does not state the amount or renewal date.

feeDetail.note: The applicable authority sets fees by license or permit type; confirm the current schedule before filing.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Get a Sussex County septage waste hauler license
items.description: A hauler that brings septage to Sussex County's treatment plants needs a county license, which costs $250.00, plus $0.080 per gallon discharged. The hauler must hold a DNREC permit or letter, a copy of the State of Delaware business license, and certificates of insurance for $500,000 commercial general liability, $1,000,000 business auto liability and Delaware workers' compensation. The county accepts waste only from properties in Sussex County, and each discharge needs a holding tank or hook-up permit number or the owner's name and address.

feeDetail.note: The applicable authority sets fees by license or permit type; confirm the current schedule before filing.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Hold a state Master Plumber license for Sussex County sewer and water work
items.description: Under section 110-61 of the Sussex County Code, anyone who installs, alters or maintains plumbing tied to sewer and water connections in the county's sewer and water districts must first hold a Master Plumber license from the State of Delaware. The county's page lists no fee.

feeDetail.note: The applicable authority sets fees by license or permit type; confirm the current schedule before filing.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.
